name: Kokeshi Kobo
description: Kokeshi Kobo — a store theme for a kokeshi doll maker, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Matcha green (#C5C56A) is the main colour: the header, the hero, every page head, the bands, the pull quotes and the footer are matcha fields with sumi-green type, deep-moss labels and lacquer-red numbers; Stick for display and Murecho for reading. The hero puts the headline on the left and, on the right, a 2.5D isometric workshop in a frame on a kokeshi pattern panel, with a cut-out kokeshi that steps out over the frame and the hero edge; the menu sits centred on its own ruled row under the shop name. Below, the making story runs as one single-column long read in four numbered chapters, then the dolls, the journal and the shop letter. The kokeshi pattern texture backs the page heads, bands and footer edge. All illustrations are generated in one 2.5D isometric style. The shop details and the wood-and-care notes each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the dolls show as static cells and orders go by email).
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-20 (single-column-longform, text-left-art-right hero, centered nav, pattern-texture images, 2.5d-isometric illustration, matcha #C5C56A, Stick + Murecho). Every picture is a 2.5D isometric raster illustration generated with Grok Build, and the kokeshi pattern is a Grok raster texture; the hero kokeshi is a transparent cut-out that breaks out of its frame and the hero (break-frame). Contrast: sumi green #1E2312 on matcha #C5C56A 8.9:1 (all text on the matcha header, hero, page heads, bands, quotes and footer); moss #3A3F1E on matcha 6.1:1 (leads, notes); deep moss #2B3016 on matcha 7.5:1 (labels, buttons; matcha on deep-moss buttons 7.5:1); lacquer red #7A2412 on matcha 5.5:1 (numbers and emphasis); sumi green on paper #F6F5E8 14.7:1; vermilion #A8361E on paper 6.0:1 (chapter numbers, emphasis); deep vermilion links #8A2C17 on paper 7.8:1; moss grey #545938 on paper 6.7:1.

fonts.role: display: headings, the wordmark, chapter numbers, vertical labels, product names
text: body, labels, navigation, buttons, prices and forms (variable weight 100-900)

store.withoutPlugin: The home kokeshi grid and the Shop page show four dolls as static cells (illustration, name, wood and height, price) linking to Contact; orders go by email and the store templates are not used.

summary.zh-TW: 抹茶綠的木芥子工房商店：左文右圖主視覺，等角插畫工房框外站出去背木芥子，單欄長文講製作，花紋質感鋪滿色帶。
summary.en: A matcha-green kokeshi workshop shop: text-left hero, a cut-out doll stepping out of an isometric frame, a one-column long read.
summary.ja: 抹茶色のこけし工房。左に見出し、右に等角の工房画、切り抜きのこけしが枠からはみ出し、一段組の長文で作り方を語る。
summary.fr: Boutique de kokeshi vert matcha : titre a gauche, poupee detouree qui sort d'un cadre isometrique, long recit sur une colonne.
summary.de: Kokeshi-Werkstatt in Matcha-Gruen: Text links, eine freigestellte Puppe tritt aus dem isometrischen Rahmen, einspaltige Langform.
